scope: Align organization-wide jefe access to joint tasks and notifications with the supervision contract.
finding: Joint-task access checked direct company membership before the jefe organization-wide rule, and notification filters repeated that membership restriction.
changes: Active jefe profiles can consult joint tasks across the organization without a direct company membership entry.
Task notification recipients and visibility now rely on the shared canWork authorization rule.
Regression covers joint-task consultation and notification to a jefe without direct company membership, and ensures an encargado loses notifications when company access is removed.
